record: O3 demand gate — evaluation populations and competence floor
frozen_before: any G0-vs-O3 demand-gate evaluation outcome exists

why_this_addendum_exists.defect: de6fb58 defined C_anchor as 'blue carrying AND n_legal_team_responses >= 2, but the C_fork precursor is NOT active'. That was written against the ORIGINAL four-condition predicate. ce7949f removed the pressure-radius and closing-trend clauses, leaving exactly 'carrying AND >= 2 legal'. Under the recall-first predicate that anchor set is EMPTY by construction: the precursor fires at the first decision satisfying precisely those conditions.
why_this_addendum_exists.confirmed_empirically: the fallback reading -- episodes where C_fork never fires -- is also empty in practice: 5,113 of 5,114 training episodes fired
why_this_addendum_exists.status: a superseded definition whose replacement was never written, not a threshold to tune

known_at_authoring: handoff_rate 0.9998; O3 controlled 86.7% of environment steps
not_known_at_authoring: any G0-vs-O3 comparison on any population
delta_fork, delta_anchor, G_available, or any behavioral distance
contamination_disclosure.why_this_is_acceptable: The anchor is chosen from the STRUCTURE of the experiment -- the phase in which O3 provably received zero gradient -- not from any observed comparison. No outcome that the gate will decide has been seen.

pre_result_prediction.prediction: BETTER_GENERALIST is more plausible than it would have been under a narrow niche trigger
pre_result_prediction.reasoning: handoff_rate 0.9998 means O3 controlled 86.7% of all environment steps. A policy trained on most of the game has little structural reason to give anything up elsewhere; the recall-first predicate bought coverage at the cost of niche specificity.
pre_result_prediction.recorded_before: any crossover result exists, so it cannot be constructed afterwards to fit the outcome

c_fork_population.definition: decisions at or after the first C_fork firing in an episode, on fresh evaluation seeds
c_fork_population.construction: paired-prefix. For each (opponent, eval_seed): arm A is G0 for the whole episode; arm B is G0 until the first C_fork firing, then O3 to terminal. Identical seeds give an identical prefix, so all divergence is attributable to the handoff.
c_fork_population.metric: final score differential, blue_score - red_score (inherited from de6fb58)
c_fork_population.requirement: delta_fork = E[U | C_fork, O3] - E[U | C_fork, G0] > 0 with LCB95 > 0

c_anchor_population.definition: natural decisions occurring BEFORE the first C_fork firing on fresh evaluation episodes
c_anchor_population.interpretation: the pre-handoff approach / setup / positioning phase
c_anchor_population.exclusion: no state at or after the first C_fork firing belongs to C_anchor
c_anchor_population.why_this_phase: O3 received ZERO PPO credit before the first handoff -- 462,412 prefix rows were offered and rejected across training, and the five pre-handoff counts were zero throughout. G0 owns that phase by construction, so it is the most defensible place to ask whether O3's post-handoff adaptation cost it anything earlier.
c_anchor_population.metric: score differential accumulated at the moment of the first C_fork firing, i.e. blue_score - red_score evaluated at the handoff step; for an episode that never fires, at terminal
c_anchor_population.why_a_phase_attributable_metric: Final-episode score cannot isolate prefix behaviour, since everything after the handoff would contaminate it. Scoring at the handoff boundary makes the quantity attributable to the phase being compared.
c_anchor_population.construction: each policy controls the episode from step 0 on the same fresh seeds; the prefix quantity is read at each arm's own first firing
c_anchor_population.requirement: delta_anchor = E[U | C_anchor, G0] - E[U | C_anchor, O3] > 0 with LCB95 > 0 -- a genuine preference REVERSAL, not non-inferiority

whole_game_comparison.definition: each policy controls the entire episode from step 0; metric is final score differential
whole_game_comparison.why_not_the_anchor: If G0 beats O3 over a whole episode we could not tell whether the advantage came from the intended pre-handoff phase or from unrelated later behaviour. Using it as the anchor would muddy the crossover claim into 'O3 is not uniformly better'.

three_way_diagnosis.C_fork: does O3 gain where it was trained?
three_way_diagnosis.C_anchor: does G0 retain an advantage before handoff?
three_way_diagnosis.whole_game: is either policy simply globally better or broken?

competence_floor.metric: win rate over the whole-game comparison
competence_floor.reference: frozen G0-V5 seed 3200001 on the same fresh evaluation seeds
competence_floor.threshold: O3 whole-game win rate >= 0.50 x G0 whole-game win rate
competence_floor.scope: pooled across opponents, and additionally reported per opponent
competence_floor.purpose: a policy that wins the niche by collapsing elsewhere is not a strategy candidate; this rejects degenerate specialists without demanding parity

inherited_unchanged_from_de6fb58.primary_metric: final score differential; carrier_survival explicitly prohibited as primary
inherited_unchanged_from_de6fb58.episodes: 7 opponents x 30 seeds = 210 episodes per arm
inherited_unchanged_from_de6fb58.g_available: V_selector({G0,O3}) - V_best_fixed({G0,O3}), selector switches to O3 at first C_fork onset, requires LCB95 > 0
inherited_unchanged_from_de6fb58.statistics: paired episode-clustered bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 12345, LCB95 = q_0.025
inherited_unchanged_from_de6fb58.behavioral_nonredundancy: behavior_pair_distance_mean >= 0.35 with the three-band classification; single-seed caveat applies

NEGATIVE_DEVELOPMENT.permitted_claim: O3 did not improve the carry-phase fork context in the canonical development seed.
NEGATIVE_DEVELOPMENT.prohibited_claim: the task does not support multiple strategies; K=1 is established
NEGATIVE_DEVELOPMENT.note: strategic demand and seed variance are unresolved at n_seeds=1, and the negative is further bounded to the 0.7006 covered carry-phase forks

BETTER_GENERALIST.permitted_claim: O3 improved on G0 in the fork context without a measurable opportunity cost in the pre-handoff phase; a better generalist, not a demonstrated second strategy.
BETTER_GENERALIST.next_experiment: C4-style opportunity-cost screen: find contexts where improving response A necessarily harms utility elsewhere

CROSSOVER_NO_REPERTOIRE_VALUE.condition: delta_fork > 0 and delta_anchor > 0, both LCB95 > 0, but LCB95(G_available) <= 0
CROSSOVER_NO_REPERTOIRE_VALUE.permitted_claim: G0 and O3 show a preference reversal, but selecting between them did not add measurable value.

COMPLEMENTARY_PAIR.condition: delta_fork > 0, delta_anchor > 0, LCB95(G_available) > 0, competence floor passed
COMPLEMENTARY_PAIR.permitted_claim: A complementary G0/O3 policy pair emerged in the canonical development seed.
COMPLEMENTARY_PAIR.prohibited_claim: reproducible strategy family; robust latent strategy; anything implying cross-seed replication
COMPLEMENTARY_PAIR.next_gate: behavioral nonredundancy, then latent birth under LATENT_BIRTH_PROTOCOL_FROZEN.json

COMPETENCE_FLOOR_FAIL.condition: O3 whole-game win rate < 0.50 x G0's
COMPETENCE_FLOOR_FAIL.permitted_claim: O3 is not a viable strategy candidate regardless of any niche gain.

immutability: After any demand-gate outcome is observed, none of the above may change: population definitions, metrics, the competence floor, the outcome conditions, or the permitted and prohibited claims.
